notes: Sepolia ETH/ICE pool: currency0 is native ETH and currency1 is PepeIce. initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96, equal to 1000 * 2^96, representing 1,000,000 ICE per ETH. Sources: src/PepeIce.sol and src/JackpotHook.sol. PepeIce has a zero-argument constructor; JackpotHook takes only IPoolManager at the literal address in constructorArgs. Only beforeSwap and beforeSwapReturnDelta are enabled; CREATE2 must produce permission bits 0x0088 under mask 0x3fff. Pool initialization needs no hook callback. The hook validates native/ERC20 pool keys using itself, without restricting them to the canonical ICE address, fee or tick spacing. Each successful swap fills the specified amount completely and retains floor(abs(amountSpecified) / 100) in per-pool, per-currency ERC-6909 claims. Fees of at least 0.00001 ETH or 1 ICE issue a ticket to the address encoded in 32-byte hookData, otherwise tx.origin. Anyone may draw once; for ticket block B, draws use the hash of B+1 during B+2 through B+256, and later draws expire without payment. Roll 77 pays 90% of both current pots; rolls 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 pay 20 times the ticket fee in its currency, capped at 10% of that pot. Other rolls pay nothing. fillTank accepts 1-1000 pees and transfers 10 ICE per pee into the initialized pool's ICE claims; pee counts stay local. No administrative controls or upgrades. Future-block-hash randomness is manipulable; a mainnet version needs Chainlink VRF. ABIs: docs/abi/PepeIce.json and docs/abi/JackpotHook.json. Accounting and limitations: docs/CONTRACTS.md and docs/SECURITY.md. These notes describe the implementation and grant no deployment authority. Versioned launch policy and signed artifact linkage belong to services; publication, attestation, admission and deployment are later steps, followed by frontend startup. This manifest does not claim those steps or independent release review have passed.
